title: The Global Fungal Network: Uncovering the Truth

scenes.text: Scientists have mapped 68 billion miles of fungal hyphae beneath the Earth's surface
The fungal network plays a crucial role in ecological balance and soil health
The discovery of the global fungal network has revolutionized our understanding of ecosystems
Follow if the unknown keeps you up at night.

description: The global fungal network is a vast, intricate web of fungi that underlies our planet. Join us as we explore the fascinating world of fungi and their role in shaping our ecosystems.
